HIGH.title: Root confinement is check-then-reopen and can be raced
HIGH.impact: _confined_file resolves, checks symlink/type/root, then returns a pathname. validate_physics_shot_artifact later reopens that pathname for parsing, Pillow decoding, and hashing. A writer with access to the shot tree can replace a checked sidecar or frame with an external symlink between those operations. The static symlink tests pass, but they do not protect this interval; identical external bytes can make validation accept a raced artifact while reading outside the shot root.
HIGH.failing_first_test: Create a valid temporary shot. Patch _confined_file so that, immediately after it returns the checked physics_state.jsonl (and separately a frame), atomically replace that entry with a symlink to an external byte-identical copy. validate_physics_shot_artifact must raise PhysicsArtifactError and must not open the external target. The current implementation instead proceeds through load_physics_capture/_sha256_file using the replaced pathname.
HIGH.required_direction: Bind validation and reads to already-open, no-follow descriptors rooted at the shot directory (or another OS-backed dirfd/openat approach), and derive parsing, image decoding, and hashing from those descriptors rather than a path revalidated earlier. Revalidation alone retains the race.

MEDIUM.title: Touched artifact validator remains above the configured size ceiling
MEDIUM.impact: The file has 368 pure LOC; the configured programming/remove-ai-slops perspective requires a responsibility split above 250 pure LOC. The current change adds sensitive confinement and validation behavior to an already oversized module, increasing review and regression risk.
MEDIUM.failing_first_test: No behavioral test is appropriate for a size-only finding. Split by responsibility only after the TOCTOU regression is locked; retain the existing observable artifact-validation tests.
